name: G-20 Trend Table — colour & type
description: The visual vocabulary of the /poj asset card. Values only — the logic mapping data onto these colours is not part of this handoff.

typography.note: System fonts only — nothing to license or ship. Weight is used sparingly: bold for values, regular for everything else.

paper.use: Page and plot background. The ground everything else is measured against.

card.use: Panels, buttons, chart cards — a hair off paper.

ink.use: Titles, primary text, and the price line when a single asset is shown.

ink2.use: Body text, legend text, secondary labels.

muted.use: Axis labels and ticks, eyebrows, sources, stat captions.

element_map._rule: Which token each thing on the card actually wears. Ramp references read <ramp>[<step>]; 'series' is step 5, 'secondary' step 4, 'wash' step 1. Text and chrome never take a ramp colour.

data_series.price_line: ink  (single asset; multi-asset takes categorical identity)
data_series.up_series: up[5]   — low_z / low_vol / low_days, displayed z_up, vol_up, days_up
data_series.down_series: down[5] — high_z / high_vol / high_days, displayed z_down, vol_down, days_down
data_series.threshold_dashes: matching ramp [4] — the +/-2 guides; must recede behind the series they annotate
data_series.regime_dot: same step as the z lines (series, step 5), so a coin's dot and its line agree
data_series.quadrant_wash: matching ramp [1], lerped from paper by cell strength
data_series.heatmap_cell: matching ramp, interpolated along the steps up to [6]

order_flow.net_position: buy_green if positive, sell_red if negative, ink2 at zero

ramps._rule: polarity picks the ramp (up=cool, down=warm); magnitude picks the step (light=weak, dark=strong). Text never wears a ramp colour.
ramps._constraint: The ramps are near-greyscale by design, so colour alone must never be the only thing separating up from down. Carry it in lightness, the legend or the label as well.

wash.use: Background tints — regime quadrants, any fill behind data.

secondary.use: Threshold dashes and envelope lines. Must recede behind the series they annotate.

series.use: Price and signal lines, regime dots. The workhorse step.

fm_max.use: Deepest heat-map cell. Nothing goes darker.

regime_grid._rule: 3x3 quadrant wash, lerped from paper toward the ramp's wash step. Mixed-extreme corners fold into neutral.

categorical._rule: Identity only (which asset), never direction. FIXED order — it is what the colour-vision optimizer maximized. Do not sort or insert. A single selected asset wears ink instead.

semantic_accents._rule: The only saturated colours in the system. Reserved for order flow and money, never for trend direction.

brand_banner._rule: Horizontal gradient, wordmark set white top-right. Rendered, not screenshotted (src/reports/branding.py).
